ref: ADR-0004 as amended for F-17 (observed #31 d3): a source queue whose context element never occurs in the message is one empty context; #2 §4 collapseContexts: "Empty contexts are replaced with an empty string" [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/saphelp_nwpi711/helpdata/en/43/c4cdfc334824478090739c04c4a249/content.htm]
note: An empty input: <Orders/> has no Order, so Qty in context Order is one empty context (F-17). collapseContexts replaces it with "": one context holding "", so the root's one slot creates one empty All. Before F-17 the queue had no context at all and the root was written without an All.
